title: Crispy Fried Chicken with Thai Aromatics
title_ms: Ayam Goreng Crispy Cicah Sos Thai
description: Sesame-battered crispy fried chicken marinated in fish sauce, finished by frying with green chilli, kaffir lime leaf and garlic for fragrance.
description_ms: Ayam goreng crispy berlapis bijan yang diperap dalam sos ikan, kemudian digoreng sekali dengan cili hijau, daun limau purut dan bawang putih untuk aroma yang wangi.
steps: Marinate the chicken with 2 tbsp fish sauce, black pepper to taste and 1 tbsp sugar; rest for 30 minutes.
Mix 2 tbsp chicken fried flour, 2 tbsp rice flour, salt and seasoning powder; add water gradually until the batter is neither too thick nor too thin.
Coat the marinated chicken pieces in the batter.
Fry in very hot oil, placing pieces in one by one; when almost done, add sliced green chilli, kaffir lime leaf and garlic cloves — all these are edible and add fragrance.
Fry until golden and crispy. Drain and serve.
steps_ms: Perap ayam dengan 2 sudu besar sos ikan, black pepper secukupnya dan 1 sudu besar gula; rehat selama 30 minit.
Gaul 2 sudu tepung goreng ayam (Bestari), 2 sudu tepung beras, garam dan serbuk perasa; masukkan air sikit-sikit sehingga adunan tidak terlalu pekat mahupun cair.
Celupkan kepingan ayam yang dah diperap ke dalam adunan.
Goreng dalam minyak betul-betul panas, masukkan satu-satu; bila hampir masak, masukkan hirisan cili hijau, daun limau purut dan bawang putih — semua ini boleh dimakan dan menambah aroma.
Goreng sehingga golden crispy. Toskan dan hidang.
